description: The U.S. Energy Information Administration retains files from the terminated EIA-412 Annual Electric Industry Financial Report. The archive lists annual files for 1990–2003. Its schedules cover balance sheets, income statements, electricity plant accounts, operating and maintenance expenses, wholesale sales, purchased power, generating-plant statistics and existing or newly added transmission lines. Earlier years are combined workbooks or ZIP archives; later years have separate XLS schedules. Some supplementary 1998–2000 tables are explicitly unedited. The provider also identifies a difference between the utilities included in the final 2003 files and the Electric Power Annual. For infrastructure simulation, these historical utility costs and asset schedules can inform investment and operating-cost models, subject to those survey and editing limits. Coverage is historical and does not establish current utility assets or finances. Access is free through the public download directory. EIA states that its government publications are public domain and requests acknowledgement. Caveats: only landing-page metadata was inspected; no spreadsheets or archives were downloaded, and field completeness and units remain unverified. Related resources are the EIA survey catalogues.
